description.en: This is not a cloud, it is just a very small sheep for your phone. It has zero thoughts, only fluffy vibes and a soft aesthetic energy. It does a tiny sit right next to your screen to make your tech look 100% more cozy. Very good at hanging out, absolutely professional at being a gentle puff.
